figures.caption: Figure 1: System architecture of DEEPMED SEARCH. The platform integrates a source-adaptive router for multi-endpoint evidence retrieval, causal introspective filtering to mitigate commonality bias, and a multi-agent debate engine to verify reasoning and synthesize reports.
